report.summary: Round 3: 4 files modified (exporters/export_sessions.py, exporters/board_config.py, exporters/export_board.py, CLAUDE.md) and 2 test files (tests/test_export_sessions.py, tests/test_export_board.py). 6 test methods added (3 VerdictOf, 1 ManualRows, 2 FutureIterations). 1 existing ManualRows test changed: ids '..x' and 'x..' moved from its accepted list to the new refused test, because CR-PBI001-06 now refuses a leading or trailing dot. Every new failing-first case failed for the right reason before the fix (4 fallback probes, 4 negation cases, 21 unsafe ids, the after-blank Later case), then passed. Suites from the worktree: tests/ 267 passed / 0 failed (261 + 6); node tests/page.test.mjs 57/57; local/tests 90 passed / 0 failed. Real specs export identical later lists before and after (dispatch-board 9, platform-catalogue 0). Nothing committed, staged, pushed or deployed; site/**, local/**, docs/** and tests/page.test.mjs untouched.

changes.why: CR-PBI001-05: verifier_outcome() reads tier 1 (JSON outcome key or Outcome: label) on its own and authoritatively; below it, tiers 2 and 3 are pooled into one set, so an un-negated fallback-declared from any form (Verdict-labelled, bold, code-quoted, bare) wins over exercised from any form. VERIFIER_TIERS itself is unchanged. Optional: NEGATED also covers 'unable to', 'rather than' and 'instead of' (with the existing be/been/being fillers). Both are used only by verifier_outcome(), which verdict_of() calls only on lane ver, so other lanes read exactly as before.

CR-PBI001-06: RUN_ID is unchanged, so it still equals local _SEGMENT and the ast drift test is still meaningful. New exporter-only UNSAFE_FILE_NAME refuses a colon, * ? < > | ", a leading dot, a trailing dot or space, and CON/PRN/AUX/NUL/COM1-9/LPT1-9 in any case with or without an extension. manual() raises the same named ValueError (runs.manual[i] (id): id '...' ...), now describing both rules.

CR-PBI001-07 (chose to keep the text): later_items() no longer ends an idea on a blank line by itself. An indented line after a blank line stays in the current idea; a blank line followed by an unindented line that starts no idea ends it, as does a horizontal rule. A top-level marker still starts a new idea. The docstring now states this rule.

Runs-table verifier sentence restates the reading order (the outcome label decides; otherwise every mention pooled; fallback-declared wins; new negations listed). Backlog later text states the after-blank-line rule. Refresh step 1 (the sentence the reviewer cited as CLAUDE.md:56) states the real manual-id rule: the local run-id form plus a safe Windows file name, with the refused characters, dots, spaces and device names.
VerdictOf failing-first tests: the reviewer's three probes plus a Verdict:-labelled variant; a pin that the outcome label still decides; negation tests for unable to / rather than / instead of

ManualRows failing-first test for Windows-unsafe ids; accepted-ids test updated (see tests[]); FutureIterations failing-first test for text after a blank line plus a pin that an unindented paragraph ends the idea

tests.covers: VerdictOf.test_without_an_outcome_label_any_fallback_wins_whatever_form_each_word_takes (the 3 reviewer probes + 'fallback-declared, as the Verdict: exercised run needs a browser'; all 4 read exercised before the fix)
VerdictOf.test_an_outcome_label_still_decides_over_any_other_mention (Outcome: exercised and JSON outcome exercised beat a bold or code-quoted fallback-declared; a pin, passed before and after)

VerdictOf.test_unable_to_rather_than_and_instead_of_negate_the_word_after_them ('unable to be exercised', 'skipped rather than exercised', 'read instead of being exercised' give None; 'exercised rather than fallback-declared' gives exercised; 4 failures before the fix)

ManualRows.test_an_id_unsafe_as_a_windows_file_name_is_refused: d:x, a?b, a*b, a|b, a"b, a<b, a>b, .x, ..x, x., x.., 'x ', CON, con.json, LPT1, prn, Aux, NUL.txt, COM1, com9.tar.gz, lpt9; each raises ValueError naming runs.manual[1] and the id (all 21 accepted before the fix)

ManualRows.test_ids_that_only_contain_dots_among_other_characters_are_accepted: '..x' and 'x..' removed from its accepted list (CR-PBI001-06 now refuses them; both are asserted refused in the new test) and replaced with a..b; it also now accepts orch-adrs-spec, orch-toolchain, CONSOLE, con-x, COM10, LPT0 and nul_x, so names that only resemble a device name are not refused
FutureIterations.test_an_indented_line_after_a_blank_line_stays_in_its_idea (the reviewer's probe: A gets 'one - nested - after blank more under A after a blank', B 'two'; failed before the fix)
FutureIterations.test_a_blank_line_then_an_unindented_line_that_starts_no_idea_ends_the_idea (a pin: a closing paragraph and the indented text under it do not join A)

ManualRows.test_the_id_form_matches_the_local_run_id_form (ast drift test: RUN_ID still equals local _SEGMENT); CommittedFiles.test_repo_config_manual_rows_are_well_formed (real board.config.json ids orch-adrs-spec, orch-toolchain); all earlier FutureIterations tests
every earlier VerdictOf, KindOf, Classify and Pipeline verdict test, unchanged and green
